title: Page 10
content_zh:
谢暖还是意犹未尽，又问：“还有后来呢？小姑娘呢？”

“再后来啊，那小姑娘长大了，就嫁给了那举子啊，还生了一堆小娃娃，最小的小女儿就叫暖暖。”

谢暖瞪大了凤眼，使劲地眨呀眨，又低头看看自己脖子上的黄金锁，再抬头看看同样凤眼含笑的父亲，脑子里有点转不过圈，直觉却让她问：“这就是那个小姑娘送给举子的黄金锁？”

“是啊。”谢雍看着锁，目光温柔似水，眼前似乎又浮现出了那个眉目如画、肌肤胜雪的小姑娘，她亲手将黄金锁递给他，目光纯澈，笑容温暖。

谢暖‘哇’了一声，又过了好半天才意会过来，问：“小姑娘是娘？”

谢雍含笑点头。

谢暖再次哇哇大叫，看向黄金锁的目光已经再没有厌恶，而是像看着一件真正的传家宝。

谢暖长大出嫁的时候，希望黄金锁成为自己的嫁妆，可惜一向对她大方的父亲却小气地不肯给她，说要将这锁留给谢家子孙，不给外姓人。

出阁前，谢暖问父亲：“你为什么不告诉娘呢？”

原宜之一直都不知道谢府黄金锁的秘密，那款黄金锁是当年皇国寺批量贩卖的长命锁，富贵人家几乎都有，并没有什么特殊标识，所以原宜之根本就没有认出来。

谢雍笑着摇头，道：“你娘经常做善事，她早已忘记了小时候的举手之劳，我又何必再告诉她呢？我自己铭记在心就足够了。”

“可是娘知道了，你们会更恩爱啊。”谢暖知道娘有着妒妇之名，非常不喜欢年轻漂亮的女人靠近爹爹。

“也或许，她知道了，只会觉得我娶她是为了报恩呢？又何必让她心里多了一道梗？”

谢暖长长的‘喔’了一声，转而又问：“那爹爹是为了报恩才娶娘的吗？所以才不顾她‘克夫’之名？”

谢雍意味深长地回答：“男人是不会为了报恩，赔上自己一生的。”

能够关注到原宜之，确实与报恩之心有关，但是越关注就越喜爱这个姑娘，后来又透过与原修之的交往，对他的妹妹多方了解，才坚定了他娶她为妻的信念。

与其说是报恩，他更愿意相信这是缘分。

他曾娶过别人，她也曾许过他人，但是阴错阳差之下，他们最终还是成就了美满姻缘。

一枚黄金锁，锁住了他的一世倾心。

原宜之生的第一个孩子，是她与谢雍的嫡长女，名谢晨。

谢晨周岁的时候，谢府门口被送来一个也约莫周岁大的小男孩，小男孩漂亮得不像话，有着一双与谢府嫡长子谢昭相似的桃花眼。

谢府内宅很是鸡飞狗跳了一阵子，下人们纷纷猜测小男孩是谢雍在外面的私生子。

小男孩名叫苏清，是曾经的名妓苏白梅的儿子。

苏清被送到谢府，苏白梅附送了一封信，信中说她不想耽误了儿子日后的前程，所以将儿子送到谢府寄养，如果谢雍夫妇不想养他，也希望看在苏清与谢昭毕竟是表兄弟的份上，让他能够回到丁家认祖归宗，给他一个清白身分。

苏白梅希望自己的儿子将来能够走科举之路，像谢雍一样光宗耀祖，但是科举对学子的要求是很严格的，必须是三代清白出身，家里不能有操贱役之人，比如下九流的媒婆、走卒、盗、窃、娼妓等等，苏白梅显然就在娼妓这一行列。

谢雍与原宜之大为头疼，苏白梅真是个藉势向上攀的女人，她这是看准了谢雍与原宜之本性善良，才藉此为自己儿子谋个出身。

谢雍派人再去找苏白梅，苏白梅已经踪迹全无。

就连原宜之也不得不承认，这个女人颇为不凡，不论是当初藉势为自己赎身，还是如今狠心与儿子永别，她都做得干净俐落。她够狠心、够舍得，又会审时度势，有心机有手段，如果她是男子，或许景国又会多一个翻手为云覆手为雨的奇男子。

只可惜她身为女子，命比纸薄。

谢雍只好派人送信给丁家，言明苏清的身分，结果丁家不认。

丁士章算盘打得比苏白梅还响亮，他知道丁家已经式微没落，谢雍又不肯再与丁家亲近，也不收他的小女儿丁锦芸，这回有了机会，倒不如把自己这个出身不光明的孙子丢到谢府养，搞不好还能沾点光。

明知丁家无耻，谢雍与原宜之也不得不收留苏清，他们总不能任凭一个刚周岁大一点的小娃娃流落街头。

谢雍认了苏清做义子。

自此苏清在谢府长住下来，与谢昭、谢晨一起念书学习，一起玩耍长大。

苏清十三岁的时候上了考场，一举考中了秀才。

此时的谢昭十九岁，也才是个秀才。

谢昭自幼体弱，并不能太劳心劳力地念书，谢雍因此也不严格要求他，只希望自己的长子能够健康平安一生就好了。

苏清很聪明，也很用功，当他明白自己不是谢雍与原宜之的亲生儿子后，他就比所有的谢家小孩都用功。

在某一点上，他继承了生母的狠劲与韧性。

苏清不仅聪明、用功，而且越来越漂亮，这个少年犹如千雕万琢之后的美玉，光华夺目，好看得让人移不开眼睛，不仅女孩子迷恋他，就连许多男人见到他也不免目眩神迷。

玄昱第一次见这个小孩，就想把他抢进皇宫里去，要不是谢雍勃然大怒地与他翻脸，玄昱只怕已经老牛吃了嫩草。

玄昱对此表示很遗憾，他还从来没见过这么漂亮的人，堪称人间奇迹。

因为这个原因，玄昱对苏清念念不忘，于是苏清的科举之路一帆风顺，青云直上，十六岁就中了进士，皇帝钦点了他为探花郎。

玄昱最喜欢钦点漂亮的进士做探花了，越漂亮越不让他做状元，就做第三名的探花，哪怕人家有状元之才。

谢雍大概要庆幸他当年科考的时候先帝还活着吧，否则他的连中三元恐怕就泡汤了。

采花郎苏清向谢雍求亲，要娶谢家最受宠爱的小女儿谢暖。

谢雍问他：“为何不是谢晨？”

苏清有点羞赧，道：“我与晨妹妹一起长大，那时候真以为自己与晨妹妹一母同胞，所以对她只有兄妹之情，再无其他男女之思。”

谢暖比苏清小了十岁，谢暖出生的时候，苏清已经懂事了，也知道了自己的身世，他看待谢暖的眼光就与看待谢晨截然不同了。

谢晨却很喜欢这个漂亮的少年，当她知道苏清居然是向妹妹求婚时，差点哭死过去。

才六岁的谢暖见姐姐哭了，立刻找到苏清将他痛打一顿，虽然她的小拳头打人不疼，却表达了她对这个漂亮哥哥破坏她们姐妹情谊的愤怒。

苏清坦然承受了自己未婚妻的甜蜜小惩罚。

原宜之也有点奇怪，她担心苏清是不是有着喜欢小女孩的怪癖，怎么会看上六岁的小娃娃，而不是自家如花似玉的大女儿？

苏清道：“再过十年，暖暖十六岁，我也才二十六，成亲也正适宜。”

苏清真的等了谢暖十年。

谢暖十六岁的时候，漂漂亮亮地出嫁了，洞房花烛夜，她问自家夫君：“你为什么就选中了我呀？”

由漂亮少年长成英俊青年的苏探花狡猾地笑道：“若说我从你一出生就爱上你了，你信吗？”

谢暖才不信呢，谁会爱上一个刚出生像红虾米一样丑的小婴儿呀？

不过，她笑咪咪地扑进夫君怀里，就这样吧，反正她相信他爱她，等了她足足十年呀。
content_en:
Xie Nuan was still not satisfied and asked: "What happens next? Where is the little girl?"

"Later, when the little girl grew up, she married that man and gave birth to a bunch of babies. The youngest daughter is called Nuannuan."

Xie Nuan's phoenix eyes widened and she blinked hard. She looked down at the golden lock around her neck, and then looked up at her father who had the same phoenix eyes and a smile. Her mind was a little confused, but her intuition made her ask: "Is this the golden lock that the little girl gave to your son?"

"Yes." Xie Yong looked at the lock, his eyes as gentle as water, and the little girl with picturesque features and skin as good as snow seemed to appear in front of his eyes. She handed the golden lock to him with her own hands, her eyes pure and her smile warm.

Xie Nuan let out a 'wow', and it took him a long time to realize, and asked: "Is the little girl the mother?"

Xie Yong smiled and nodded.

Xie Nuan screamed again, looking at the golden lock no longer with disgust, but as if looking at a real heirloom.

When Xie Nuan grew up and got married, she hoped that the golden lock would become her dowry. Unfortunately, her father, who had always been generous to her, stingily refused to give it to her, saying that he would leave the lock to the descendants of the Xie family and not to anyone with a foreign surname.

Before leaving the cabinet, Xie Nuan asked his father: "Why didn't you tell mother?"

Yuan Yizhi never knew the secret of the Xie Mansion's golden lock. That golden lock was a long-life lock that was sold in bulk by Huangguo Temple. Almost all wealthy people had it. There was no special mark on it, so Yuan Yizhi didn't recognize it at all.

Xie Yong smiled and shook his head and said: "Your mother often does good deeds. She has already forgotten the little efforts she made when she was a child. Why should I tell her again? It is enough for me to keep it in mind."

"But if mother knows, you will be more affectionate." Xie Nuan knew that mother was known as a jealous woman and didn't like young and beautiful women to get close to her father.

"Perhaps, if she knows, she will only think that I married her to repay my kindness? Why should I make it more difficult for her?"

Xie Nuan let out a long "Oh" and then asked: "Did dad marry mom to repay his kindness? Is that why he ignored her name as a 'concubine'?"

Xie Yong replied meaningfully: "A man will not sacrifice his life in order to repay a favor."

Being able to pay attention to Yuan Yizhi is indeed related to the desire to repay gratitude, but the more he pays attention, the more he falls in love with this girl. Later, through his association with Yuan Xiuzhi, he got to know his sister in many ways, which strengthened his belief in marrying her.

Rather than saying it was repaying a favor, he preferred to believe that it was fate.

He had married someone else, and she had promised to someone else, but due to a strange combination of circumstances, they finally achieved a happy marriage.

A golden lock locked his lifelong love.

Yuan Yi's first child was her and Xie Yong's eldest daughter, named Xie Chen.

When Xie Chen was one year old, a little boy who was about one year old was sent to the door of Xie Mansion. The little boy was extremely beautiful, with a pair of peach blossom eyes similar to Xie Zhao, the eldest son of Xie Mansion.

There was a lot of excitement in the Xie Mansion for a while, and the servants all speculated that the little boy was Xie Yong's illegitimate son outside.

The little boy's name is Su Qing, the son of Su Baimei, a former famous prostitute.

Su Qing was sent to the Xie Mansion, and Su Baimei attached a letter. The letter said that she did not want to delay her son's future future, so she sent her son to the Xie Mansion for foster care. If Xie Yong and his wife did not want to raise him, they also hoped that for the sake of Su Qing and Xie Zhao being cousins ​​after all, they would allow him to return to the Ding family to recognize his ancestors and give him a clean identity.

Su Baimei hopes that her son will take the imperial examination route in the future and honor his ancestors like Xie Yong. However, the requirements for the imperial examination are very strict for students. They must be of clean origin for three generations, and there must not be anyone in the family who is engaged in low-level labor, such as low-level matchmakers, pawns, thieves, thieves, prostitutes, etc. Su Baimei is obviously in the ranks of prostitutes.

Xie Yong and Yuan Yi were in a big headache. Su Baimei was really a woman who took advantage of the opportunity to climb up. She took advantage of the good nature of Xie Yong and Yuan Yi, so she took this opportunity to find a career for her son.

Xie Yong sent someone to look for Su Baimei again, but there was no trace of Su Baimei.

Even Yuan Yizhi had to admit that this woman was quite extraordinary. Whether she used the opportunity to redeem herself or now cruelly bid farewell to her son, she did it neatly.She is cruel and willing enough, and she is also able to assess the situation, and has scheming and means. If she were a man, maybe Jingguo would have another strange man who can turn clouds and rain with his hands.

It's a pity that as a woman, her life is thinner than paper.

Xie Yong had no choice but to send someone to deliver a letter to the Ding family stating Su Qing's identity, but the Ding family refused to acknowledge it.

Ding Shizhang's abacus was louder than Su Baimei's. He knew that the Ding family was in decline, and Xie Yong was no longer willing to be close to the Ding family, nor would he accept his youngest daughter Ding Jinyun. Now that he had the opportunity, he might as well throw his grandson, who had a shady background, into the Xie Mansion to raise him, and maybe he could get some glory.

Knowing that the Ding family was shameless, Xie Yong and Yuan Yizhi had to take Su Qing in. They couldn't let a little baby who was just one year old live on the street.

Xie Yong recognized Su Qing as his adopted son.

From then on, Su Qing lived in Xie Mansion, studying, studying, and playing together with Xie Zhao and Xie Chen.

When Su Qing was thirteen years old, he went to the examination room and passed the examination as a scholar.

At this time, Xie Zhao was nineteen years old and a scholar.

Xie Zhao was frail since he was a child and could not study too hard. Therefore, Xie Yong did not impose strict requirements on him. He only hoped that his eldest son would be healthy and safe throughout his life.

Su Qing is very smart and studious. When he realized that he was not the biological son of Xie Yong and Yuan Yizhi, he worked harder than all the Xie family children.

At one point, he inherited his biological mother's fierceness and resilience.

Su Qing is not only smart and diligent, but also more and more beautiful. This young man is like a beautiful jade that has been carved thousands of times. He is so dazzling and beautiful that people can't take their eyes away. Not only girls are obsessed with him, but also many men can't help but be dazzled when they see him.

The first time Xuan Yu saw this child, he wanted to snatch him into the palace. If Xie Yong hadn't turned against him in a rage, Xuan Yu would have eaten the young grass.

Xuan Yu expressed regret for this. He had never seen such a beautiful person before, which can be called a miracle on earth.

For this reason, Xuan Yu never forgot about Su Qing, so Su Qing's imperial examination road was smooth sailing, and he became a Jinshi at the age of sixteen, and the emperor appointed him as Tan Hua Lang.

Xuan Yu most likes to appoint beautiful Jinshi to be the top pick. The prettier he is, the less he will be allowed to be the top pick. He will be the third top pick, even if he has the talent to be the top pick.

Xie Yong must be lucky that the late emperor was still alive when he took the scientific examination, otherwise his three-yuan winning streak would have been in vain.

Su Qing, a flower picker, proposed to Xie Yong to marry Xie Nuan, the most beloved daughter of the Xie family.

Xie Yong asked him: "Why not Xie Chen?"

Su Qing was a little shy and said: "Sister Chen and I grew up together. At that time, I really thought that I and Sister Chen had the same mother and father, so I only had a brother-sister relationship with her and no other thoughts about men or women."

Xie Nuan was ten years younger than Su Qing. When Xie Nuan was born, Su Qing was already sensible and knew his own life experience. His eyes on Xie Nuan were completely different from those on Xie Chen.

Xie Chen liked this beautiful young man very much. When she found out that Su Qing actually proposed to her sister, she almost cried to death.

When Xie Nuan, who was only six years old, saw her sister crying, she immediately found Su Qing and beat him up. Although her little fist didn't hurt, it expressed her anger at this beautiful brother for destroying their sisterhood.

Su Qing calmly accepted the sweet little punishment from his fiancée.

Yuan Yizhi was also a little strange. She was worried that Su Qing had a peculiar tendency to like little girls. Why would she fall in love with a six-year-old baby instead of her eldest daughter who is as beautiful as a flower?

Su Qing said: "In ten years, Nuannuan will be sixteen years old, and I will only be twenty-six. It will be just right for me to get married."

Su Qingzhen has been waiting for Xie Nuan for ten years.

When Xie Nuan was sixteen years old, she got married beautifully. During the wedding night, she asked her husband: "Why did you choose me?"

Su Tanhua, who has grown from a beautiful boy to a handsome young man, smiled slyly: "If you say that I have fallen in love with you since you were born, would you believe it?"

Xie Nuan didn't believe it. Who would fall in love with a newborn baby as ugly as red shrimp?

However, she threw herself into her husband's arms with a smile, and that was it. Anyway, she believed that he loved her and had been waiting for her for ten years.
